threat_summary: Threat intel reports phishing pages that trick users into granting OAuth apps access to mailbox data without using malware.
hunt_checklist: Filter high-risk mail or file scopes.
Check sign-in and mailbox activity after consent.
List all users granting same app.
correlation_logic: Correlate behavior on the same host/user within a 24-hour window unless the report specifies a narrower time range.
escalation_condition: Escalate when a newly consented app has mail/file scopes and access activity follows.
analyst_notes: Generated as synthetic gold output for MVP evaluation. Queries should be reviewed against the real SIEM/EDR schema.
